office_does: The district court judge hears misdemeanors, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to $100,000 and protection orders, and holds felony preliminary hearings.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Eric C. Biggar, on the district court bench since 2018 and a county prosecutor for about 23 years before that, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Douglas County District Court Judge since 2018, previously about 23 years as a deputy and chief criminal deputy prosecutor; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Deputy and chief criminal deputy prosecutor in Douglas County until 2014 [S1]
